title: Yeasty Argentinian Empanada
description: A festive, low-carb-friendly empanada featuring ginger and a snappy yeast dough. Perfect for any meal, especially as a snack or breakfast.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the flour, sugar and salt. Add the warm water and mix until a shaggy dough forms.
Add the yeast to the dough and mix until fully incorporated.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Place the dough in a greased bowl, cover and let rest for 1 hour, or until doubled in size.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk, about 1/8 inch thick.
In a pan over medium heat, cook 1 tablespoon of oil for 1 minute.
Place one empanada disk in the pan and cook for 30 seconds, until slightly browned.
Add 1-2 teaspoons of your desired filling to the center of the empanada.
Fold the empanada in half and press edges to seal.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the bottom is golden brown.
Fl flip the empanada and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the other side is also golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining dough and filling.
Serve with your favorite dipping sauce.
Note: This recipe can be made in advance and frozen for up to 2 months. Simply thaw and cook as directed.
